We signed up and fundamentally created the ECHR for this sole purpose; so that when domestic governments, elected or not, choose to violate the rights of citizens, there is an accountable body to ensure standards are kept. Baring in mind the ECHR and EU are separate institutions and, as I hope you are aware, Strasbourg, under s.2 of the Human Rights Act 1998, has very little influence over domestic policy. This is simply to highlight an issue and the injunction  will be lifted when the case is heard or not.
